sloka: अभेद्यकवचं मत्वा लक्ष्मणं रावणात्मजः।ललाटे लक्ष्मणं बाणैः सुपुङ्खैस्त्रिभिरिन्द्रजित्।अविध्यत् परमक्रुद्धः शीघ्रास्त्रं च प्रदर्शयन् ।। ६.९१.३३ ।।
transliteration: abhedyakavacaṁ matvā lakṣmaṇaṁ rāvaṇātmajaḥ।lalāṭe lakṣmaṇaṁ bāṇaiḥ supuṅkhaistribhirindrajit।avidhyat paramakruddhaḥ śīghrāstraṁ ca pradarśayan ।। 6.91.33 ।।

translations.english: Ravana's son, knowing that it is not possible to break the shield of Lakshmana, quickly showed his weapon with three arrows with plumes and gems and struck him on the forehead.
